title: Changing contributions of emotion and reward information to learning through adolescence.
summary: From childhood to adulthood, individuals' learning and decision-making may be differentially impacted by two salient value signals for adolescents: emotions and rewards. This study superimposed these information sources to assess their independent and joint influences on learning and choice processes. Participants ages 8 to 22 y completed a reinforcement learning task, in which monetary rewards conveyed information integral to making reward-maximizing choices, while emotional expressions conveyed information incidental to this goal. In some conditions, emotion and reward invoked congruent approach-avoid tendencies; following either information source promoted making reward-maximizing ("correct") choices. In other conditions, emotion and reward invoked incongruent approach-avoid tendencies; following the emotion cue impeded reward capture. Participants completed several measures indexing the persistence of emotion and reward information on choice and evaluations of these signals. Statistical and computational models revealed that emotion-reward incongruence hampered early learning through an incidental emotion bias on value estimates. The emotion bias decayed as reward learning progressed in adolescents and adults but endured in children. Moreover, reward-based choice increased with age across the additional measures. Although participants of all ages were initially hindered by incidental emotion cues, adults' shift toward prioritizing integral reward outcomes indicates that goal-relevant information comes to dominate choice with age.

相关性：是
标题：青春期情绪与奖励信息在学习中贡献的变化
摘要：从童年到成年，个体的学习与决策可能受到两种对青少年尤为突出的价值信号的不同影响：情绪与奖励。本研究将这两种信息来源叠加呈现，以考察它们对学习与选择过程的独立影响与联合影响。8至22岁的参与者完成了一项强化学习任务，其中金钱奖励传递了对做出奖励最大化选择不可或缺的信息，而情绪表情传递的信息则与该目标无关。在某些条件下，情绪与奖励引发一致趋近—回避倾向；追随任一信息来源均促进做出奖励最大化（“正确”）的选择。在其他条件下，情绪与奖励引发不一致的趋近—回避倾向；追随情绪线索会阻碍对奖励的获取。参与者完成了若干测量，以索引情绪与奖励信息对选择及对这些信号评价的持续影响。统计模型与计算模型揭示，情绪—奖励不一致通过情绪对价值估计的附带性偏差妨碍了早期学习。该情绪偏差在青少年和成人中随奖励学习推进而衰减，但在儿童中持续存在。此外，在额外测量中，基于奖励的选择随年龄增长而增加。尽管所有年龄段的参与者最初都受到附带性情绪线索的妨碍，但成人转向优先考虑不可或缺的奖励结果，表明与目标相关的信息随年龄增长逐渐主导选择。
关键词：情绪；奖励学习；青春期；趋近—回避倾向；价值估计

title: Understanding consciousness (biological and artificial) as a society of self-schemas.
summary: This article argues that human cognition is more than the performance of functions such as memory, decision-making, and attention. The brain also builds schematic models of those cognitive functions and uses those models to monitor, predict, and partially control them. When you introspect, your understanding of who you are and what is happening inside of you is derived from those schematic, sometimes inaccurate, but generally useful models, rather than from the actual cognitive functions that are represented by those models. The proposal expands the previously proposed attention schema theory to a more general schema theory, in which the mind as we know it introspectively is a society of interacting self-schemas. The article focuses on five self-schemas including the attention schema (which is proposed to give us our intuitions about a conscious mind that takes possession of items in a vivid manner), a decision schema (which generates simplified, sometimes confabulated accounts of the decision-making process and gives us our intuitive understanding of agency and will), emotion schemas (which create complex interpretations of the physiological state of the body and provide us with our understanding of emotional experience), the body schema (which provides our understanding of who we are as physical beings), and personas (which give us our understanding of our emotional, social, and moral character, and act as a framework to guide our behavior). The article includes a discussion of how consciousness in a machine requires a similar suite of self-schemas used for similar functional purposes and may already be partially present.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：将意识（生物与人工）理解为自我图式的社会
摘要：本文主张，人类认知不仅仅是记忆、决策和注意等功能的执行。大脑还会为这些认知功能构建图式模型，并利用这些模型对其进行监控、预测和部分控制。当你进行内省时，你对自身是谁以及内在正在发生什么的理解，源自这些图式的、有时不准确但通常有用的模型，而非这些模型所代表的实际认知功能。该 proposal 将此前提出的注意图式理论扩展为更一般的图式理论，其中我们所内省地了解的 mind 是一个由相互作用的自我图式组成的社会。本文聚焦于五种自我图式，包括注意图式（据提出，它赋予我们关于一个有意识心灵以生动方式占有对象的直觉）、决策图式（它生成对决策过程的简化、有时是虚构化的叙述，并赋予我们对能动性和意志的直觉理解）、情绪图式（它创造对身体生理状态的复杂解释，并为我们提供对情绪体验的理解）、身体图式（它提供我们作为物理存在是谁的理解）以及人格面具（它赋予我们对自己情绪、社会和道德品格的理解，并作为指导我们行为的框架）。本文还讨论了机器中的意识如何需要一套类似的、用于类似功能目的的自我图式，并且可能已经部分存在。
关键词：意识；自我图式；注意图式理论；情绪图式；人工意识
